parent_session.reason: The v03 leading-mantle preparation was never artist-edited. Production therefore begins from the exact reviewed v02 recovery rather than pretending an unrun local pass is a master asset.

candidate.role: hidden immutable raw topology and depth prior; never likeness authority, canonical source or runtime input

primary_trace.role: sole primary-view likeness, silhouette and landmark authority

production_brief.intent: Produce one coherent organic Collector, not a chain of isolated local repairs. The locked primary trace decides silhouette, six dorsal masses, ground contact and negative space; diagnostic views prevent flat cards, torn ribbons and accidental hidden geometry.
source_order: primary gesture and low broad silhouette
six descending overlapping dorsal shell masses
long low underbody with thick articulated supports and real contacts
forbidden: texture concealment of incorrect dominant masses
runtime export, rigging or infection registration before visual acceptance

topology_policy.starting_mesh: the exact v02 recovered working mesh, hidden immutable v05 raw mesh and all historical evidence
allowed: direct sculpt and vertex deformation on the existing working surface
local connected retopology, split, bridge, merge and delete on that same surface
protected whole-mesh backups and deterministic evidence capture
semantic vertex groups that guide an artist but never perform a field deformation
forbidden: scripted broad vertex masks or pixel-curve field deformation

passes.region: the existing tagged working surface, addressed in the declared production-brief order during one protected coherent form session
passes.primary_goal: replace the C-loop mantle, fused dorsal ridge, blocky supports and hanging rear plate with one low broad Collector composition that follows the locked source-pixel trace
passes.diagnostic_goal: retain attached visible thickness, readable support separation, no cards, ribbons, holes, new components or hidden self-intersections
passes.authoring_requirement: A visible Blender artist uses the bounded Collector Master session only. Intermediate sculpture rounds are saved and captured, but no external acceptance decision occurs until the whole form pass is complete.

passes.region: the accepted connected production-master form surface
passes.primary_goal: remove generator dents, accidental seams and shredded overlaps without changing the accepted large silhouette or losing material hierarchy
passes.diagnostic_goal: retain coherent organic continuity through the five neutral and four animation frames
passes.authoring_requirement: This pass opens only after independent review records a continue decision for production_master_form_v01.

review_gate.before_each_pass: the declared predecessor must have its deterministic audit receipt and recorded independent continue decision; the baseline is captured before the first mesh edit
review_gate.after_each_pass: capture primary, silhouette, trace, opposite, front, side and elevated-rear frames. The form pass also compares raw v05 and the master candidate through the blind pairwise protocol before raw identity or overlays are revealed.
review_gate.acceptance: literal primary overlay, normal visual review, animation/material review, blind comparison and the 85/100 contour contract are all mandatory. Scalar metrics diagnose only and cannot accept or rank the mesh.
